skills.name: Like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators, including cases with a zero result.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Find equivalent fractions with a common denominator and subtract fractions with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract whole numbers, fractions, or mixed numbers when the fractional part of the minuend is large enough and no regrouping is needed.

skills.name: Regrouping and renaming
skills.definition: Rename or regroup whole and mixed numbers, including improper fractional parts, when subtraction cannot be done directly.
